description:
Implement arbitrary-degree polynomial quotient extension fields in gf2-core with a runtime-configured modulus, defining the reference semantics of the pair.

## Background

The current tower types support only binomial moduli of degree two and three. The runtime form defines `quotient-extension-api`: representation, reduction, inversion, Frobenius, base embedding, and the algebraic field identity. Irreducibility validation and certificates come from the dedicated validation operation. Materialization beyond `usize`/`u128` limits returns a typed unsupported-size error.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: A runtime quotient extension over supported base fields constructs from a certificate-validated modulus and satisfies the shared field-law conformance suite.
- [hard] REQ-02: The type implements the extension abstraction and carries the algebraic field identity fixed by the extension design.
- [hard] REQ-03: Materialization beyond `usize`/`u128` limits reports the typed unsupported-size error.
title: Implement runtime-configured polynomial quotient extension fields
